purpose: Replicate or falsify the R39U finding that same-competition analog-kNN draw probability ranks actual draws in the wrong direction, using a disjoint deterministic 100-match sample from repository-existing point_in_time.csv data only.

sample.selection: reconstruct R39U fixed100 from its frozen seed, exclude those 100 keys, then rank remaining eligible rows by sha256(R39V seed|match_key), first 100

algorithm.standardization: median/IQR fitted separately on each target match strictly-prior pool only
algorithm.vote: inverse-distance weighted H/D/A empirical vote with epsilon=1e-6
algorithm.prediction: unchanged R39U argmax H/D/A; no inversion applied to prediction

primary_test.definition: ROC AUC for score 1 - base_knn_pD, equivalent to 1 - base draw AUC absent ties
primary_test.replication_gate: inverse_draw_auc_at_k25 > 0.60 AND mean_base_pD_actual_draw < mean_base_pD_actual_non_draw AND at least 2 of 3 k values have inverse_draw_auc > 0.55
primary_test.interpretation_if_pass: R39U inverse-ranking mechanism replicates and may proceed to a separately preregistered strictly-prior learned residual model; no formal promotion.
primary_test.interpretation_if_fail: Treat the R39U inverse-ranking observation as non-replicated and stop this mechanism.
